names.note: The nominative the day page's own `/name/9448.html` link carries in its `title`, «Александр (Саульский), иерей, сщмч.», with the two trailing rank words left off; the surname in parentheses is part of the name and stays. The day's line prints «Александра» twice; this is the second of the two, name link 9448 against the first's 9424. `fk.mjs` on this form returned NONE before the write, in a corpus holding some dozens of folders of the bare forename.

death.note: The year days.pravoslavie.ru prints at the end of its line for 19 мая ст. ст., which is the year for all fourteen people that line names. His name page gives no year at all and no year of birth.

source.text: Православный церковный календарь, Сретенский монастырь (days.pravoslavie.ru), 19 мая ст. ст. — «Сщмчч. Антония , еп. Белгородского, и с ним Митрофана , Александра , Михаила , Ипполита , Николая , Василия , Николая , Максима , Александра , Павла , Павла , Георгия пресвитеров и мч. Михаила (1938).»

attestations.note: Ninth of the thirteen named «и с ним» after the bishop of Belgorod, and the second of the line's two Alexanders, told apart from the first only by the name links, 9448 and 9424. **The line and the name link are all there is**: 9448 is a heading, the grade and two days, «26 января (Новомуч.) , 19 мая», with no narrative; the 26 января is the synaxis of the new martyrs, a company's feast and not a second day of his own. azbyka.ru was not read.
